headline: Congress named a Charlotte, North Carolina post office after civil rights lawyer Julius L. Chambers.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2505 Derita Avenue in Charlotte, North Carolina. The building is now called the Julius L. Chambers Civil Rights Memorial Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 3, 2020.
